provider.name: MycoBank
provider.organization_type: global fungal nomenclatural registration, name, typification, bibliography, culture, sequence-link, persistent-identifier, API, download, and editorial infrastructure
provider.description: MycoBank is a global fungal nomenclatural registry and information system. It provides persistent MycoBank identifiers, registrations for new fungal names and nomenclatural acts, scientific names, authorship, ranks, publication data, types, specimens, cultures, sequence links, synonyms, classifications, protected, conserved, rejected and sanctioned names, editorial review, downloads, and machine services.
institutional_context: International Mycological Association and International Commission on the Taxonomy of Fungi
International Code of Nomenclature for algae, fungi, and plants
Global fungal taxonomists, nomenclature specialists, journals, fungaria, culture collections, and sequence repositories

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting MycoBank documentation, registration procedures, nomenclature, names, authors, types, specimens, cultures, sequences, references, classifications, identifiers, status vocabularies, APIs, downloads, schemas, editorial workflows, legal conditions, publications, institutions, standards, and related fungal authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: MycoBank, the Westerdijk Institute, the ICN, IMA and ICTF bodies, official registrations, official releases, official API documentation, cited publications, type repositories, culture collections, and sequence databases remain authoritative for names, identifiers, typification, status, versions, legal conditions, and contacts.
